index.description: News that changes how you choose a place to stay in Finnish Lapland. Every story is written from the original source, which is named and linked.
index.lead: What is changing in Lapland accommodation, written from the original sources. Every story names and links what it is based on.
index.aboutText: We open every source before writing and report only what it says. Where a number is missing from the source, we say so instead of filling the gap.
